senses.gloss: m. pl. (ἀζαραπατεῖς, Pers. hazâr paiti; v. Perl. Et. St. p. 118, a. authorities quot. ib.) name of a class of oppressive Persian officers (chiliarchi).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:9">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 139a:8">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite>. [Ar. <he>גאזי דפטי</he>, <he>גזי דפ׳</he>; Var. <he>גזיר פ׳</he>, <he>גזיר דפ׳</he>, <he>גרז דיפטי</he>, <he>גיזרפטי</he>, <he>גוזרפ׳</he> &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. c.]
